scenes.say: Your auditors just sent a P.B.C. list. What is it?

scenes.desc: The schedules and documents your team prepares for the audit.

scenes.say: P.B.C. means prepared by client. It's the list of schedules and documents your team provides, so the audit can start.
cap: It's the list of schedules and documents your team provides, so the audit can start.

scenes.say: Typical items: bank and receivables reconciliations, fixed asset registers, stock listings and aged payables. Ready before fieldwork means fewer questions later.
